scripts.dev: bun run build:worker && bun run src/main.ts
scripts.build:worker: bun build ../../packages/proxy/src/post-processor.worker.ts --outfile dist/post-processor.worker.js --target=bun && bun build ../../packages/runtime-server/src/retention-cleanup.worker.ts --outfile dist/retention-cleanup.worker.js --target=bun && bun -e "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist/post-processor.worker.js', 'dist/retention-cleanup.worker.js']) chmodSync(path, 0o644)"
scripts.build: bun run build:worker && bun build src/main.ts --compile --outfile dist/ccflare --target=bun
